name: Job Seeker Permit for Skilled Workers

qualifying_event.description: For skilled workers seeking employment in Norway without yet having a job offer -- meeting one of the same qualification tiers as the Skilled Worker permit, plus sufficient own funds.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Qualification documents (vocational, degree, or experience certificates); proof of own funds, typically in a Norwegian bank account.

requirements.blocker_text: One of: a completed 3+ year upper-secondary vocational training programme, a university/college degree, or 6+ years of documented equivalent work experience.
At least NOK 28,448/month (approx. NOK 341,373/year) in own funds, typically in a Norwegian bank account (PhD candidates need only NOK 85,344 regardless of stay length).

evidence_required.document: Proof of own funds (Norwegian bank account)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, not renewable as a job-seeker permit

sources.title: UDI -- Job seekers: same 3 qualification tiers as skilled worker permit, NOK 28,448/month funds requirement (NOK 85,344 for PhD holders), up to 1-year permit, full/part-time work allowed excluding self-employment

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway). Distinct bridge route from no_work_permit.json: holders may work full-time or part-time WHILE job-hunting (including in jobs that don't require skilled qualifications), but cannot be self-employed or run their own business. Once a qualifying job offer is secured, the applicant switches to no_work_permit.json rather than renewing this permit -- it does not itself lead to permanent residence or citizenship, and time on it does not appear to count toward either clock per the sources reviewed.
